notes.title: Small bug patch (1.18.1)
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added more fall backs to spawning system to keep it running smoothly.
[/list]
Small fixes for the spawning system. This should help keep the spawn system running smoothly even if it encounters any issues or if it struggles to initialize after migrating server host.

Thank you to anyone who has reported a bug recently! These reports help me make Cryptid Farm the best it can be 😄 I'll keep trying to be vigilant for any bugs or issues that appear and try to get fixes out as quickly as possible.

- FistFlame

notes.title: Fixes and Balancing (1.18.0)
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with control rebinding (Tractor fixing and harvesting now works correctly with new controls)
[*][spoiler]UFO now picks a different target if it loses its first one[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]UFO beam now escapable by entering the house before levitating.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]UFO now has a maximum life span.[/spoiler]
[/list]
Balancing:
[list]
[*]Chupacabra delay before chase increased by 1 second.
[*]Multi-spawns slightly reduced at the first difficulty.
[/list]
Today's update includes some quality-of-life changes for first time players. I've slowed the Chupacabra's entrance by a small delay to give players more of a chance to recognise the incoming danger. I’ve also reduced the multi-spawns at the first difficulty stage again (mainly night spawns) to give a bit more lee-way to learning players.

The [spoiler]UFO[/spoiler] also got some attention this patch too. Some simple adjustments to the code should make it a more fun and stable encounter now. 

Finally, I’ve fixed an overlooked issue with the control rebinding: the command to harvest crops and to hold to fix the tractor were meant to work through the “Water” command, but weren’t working with any changed controls. This has now been fixed. More controller support still in development!

Thanks for reading!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Small bug patch (1.17.8)
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed "Player Total" setting.
[*] Fixed "UI scale" setting.
[*] Fixed some additional menu issues.
[/list]
Hello again! Some more small fixes in this update. The "Player Total" option wasn't working as expected which is now fixed. Also, the "UI scale" display option has been fixed to be functional in this update. If you ever thought the in-game UI was too large or small, you can now adjust its scale using this option (though it is still an experimental option for the time being).

That's all for now, thanks for reading!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Small bug patch (1.17.7)
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a very rare shop bug.

notes.title: Fixes and Balancing (1.17.6)
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] 100% achievement fixed (Plus will activate for players upon game start up if requirements met)
[*] Theft achievement fixed (No longer activates on own crops after death)
[*] Dynamic camera setting fixes
[*] Slight bit more controller support in main menu (more to come still)
[*] Other small fixes for consistent controls
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Fast Ellie now starts slow and quickly increases in speed rather than starting off fast
[*] Second difficulty stage comes slightly later
[/list]

Hello Cryptid Farmers! I hope you've all been well, sorry for the long wait between this update and the last! I've been working on the game behind the scenes where I can to smooth out issues as I spot them. Once again, thank you for your patience with the achievements, I will continue to monitor them and make sure they're all working eventually. Thank you to anyone who submitted a post to notify me of any bugs with them! Controller support is still in the works, I'm still getting to grips with Unity's UI system for controller inputs.

I might not have mentioned, but Cryptid Farm is on a big sale right now! It's been accepted as part of the Four Is A Party sale from Daedalic Entertainment. This runs until next Monday the 16th. If you have any friends who may been on the fence, now is a great time to pick up the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717126/b5af5a3485e05ec81011fd17961a591c12cfa745.png[/img]

For now, thanks for reading!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Fixes and Balancing (1.17.5)
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Harvest achievement fixed
[*] Massacre achievement fixed
[*] Effect volume slider fixed (some audio sources were not following correctly)
[*] Back button added for controller (more to come!)
[/list]
Balancing:
[list]
[*] Chupacabra spawn rate slightly decreased at higher difficulties
[*] Multi-spawns and Mothman abduction event rate slightly decreased at first difficulty
[*] Cardio Achievement reduced to 6 sprint speed
[/list]

Today’s update fixes a few things and balances a few more. After reviewing some gameplay footage from all of the wonderful creators who have made videos and streams of the game, I noticed that the Chupacabra was spawning much more frequently late game than I intended it to. As much as I love speedy bat dog, this was forcing players to stay inside for longer which felt a bit more annoying than was intended. In addition, some players were getting overwhelmed by repeated deaths and high difficulty when first starting off. These changes should hopefully let players get into the game faster and keep enjoying it for longer!

I once again thank you for your patience with the achievements and for all of your bug reports, they keep me improving the game and fixing things for everyone ASAP! There’s nothing worse than finding a bug long after the game’s release so I’m always happy when it’s brought to my attention sooner rather than later. If you encounter any further bugs, feel free to make a Steam community post (which I do go through and read!) or message the Cryptid Farm Community Discord and I’ll get right on it.

Whilst I still want to upgrade the networking solution as mentioned in a previous update, I’m going to keep working at getting controller support fully working now. I love the idea of people being able to play Cryptid Farm on their Steam Deck or TV! Also, I will look into adding a feature to allow players to return tilled ground to grass again.

Thanks for reading!

- FistFlame

notes.title: Post-launch patch (1.17.4)
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Enabled use of the pause key to exit from various menus.
[*] Added prompt to the tractor to help guide players when they have tractor parts in their inventory.
[*] Disabled UI hiding debug button.
[/list]

Just a few small changes that I think make the experience easier for new players.

I just wanted to mention how blown away I am by the recent game activity. Thank you everyone for taking an interest in Cryptid Farm! I'd also like to thank the YouTubers Dead Squirrel, H20Delirous, CaRtOoNz and Kyle for their recent videos on the game. Check out their channels if you have a moment!

My next development goal will likely be to do with upgrading the current server solutions.

Thanks for reading! 😄
- FistFlame

notes.title: Halloween patch (1.17.3)
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added fan submitted pumpkins for Halloween 2024.
[*] Added credits for the fans that submitted a design this year.
[/list]

Happy Halloween! This is just a small patch to add some extra pumpkin fan designs that were submitted in the Cryptid Farm discord server (the "pumpkin patch" if you will!). These new designs have been added to the overall pool of designs which you may see in game!

Wanted to submit a design? I'm still happy to receive pumpkin designs in the Cryptid Farm discord or at the Cryptid Farm email: cryptidfarm@gmail.com .

Future patches will likely focus on some quality of life changes for the UI and tractor fixing, hopefully meaning less hassle with closing menus.

Thanks for reading and have a spooky day!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Launch patch 3 (1.17.2)
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Additional fixes for achievements (specifically for "The sound of forgiveness" achievement).
[*] Create server menu now creates private servers by default.
[*] Mothman tracking code updated for non-host clients.
[*] Chupacabra failsafe added for non-host clients reaching the safe area.
[/list]

Thank you once again for your patience whilst I fix the achievements still, this should hopefully be the last needed update for these, but please let me know if anything seems off.

I hope everyone's been having fun with the game! It still doesn't feel real to have released onto Steam. The launch has been very successful (despite the needed updates) and I've been happy to see so many people playing :)

Thanks for reading!
- FistFlame
